releases.name: Version 1.0.3
releases.body:
- Added simplified Chinese translation
  - Thank you to SanBaiMing for making the translation, and xen 10 for helping with some code issues that were making it not work properly!
- I have no idea why v1.0.2 was never released properly, so I'm just gonna leave it unreleased and move on to v1.0.3
releases.bodyZh:
- 添加了简体中文翻译
  - 感谢三百万明(SanBaiMing)制作翻译，以及xen 10帮助解决一些导致其无法正常运行代码问题！
- 我不知道为什么v1.0.2从未正式发布，所以我只是把它留作未发布状态，继续推进到v1.0.3

releases.name: Version 1.0.1
releases.bodyZh: 添加了有用的弹出人物。

releases.name: Version 1.0.0
releases.body: Initial release for the mod jam! Use a strange Nomai device to go into the minds of your fellow Hearthian, in hopes of convincing them to evacuate!
releases.bodyZh: 模组节初始发布！使用一个奇特的挪麦装置，进入你的哈斯人同伴的意识中，希望能说服他们撤离！
